text: わかもの　との　しょうぶ　こそ　じんせいの　たのしみ！

structure.jp: わかもの　との　しょうぶ　こそ
structure.en: battling with young people, that above all,

structure.jp: じんせいの　たのしみ！

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts a spotlight on the word before it: 'this, and nothing else'. しょうぶ こそ = 'battling is the very thing'.

patterns.name: 〜との
patterns.span: わかもの　との　しょうぶ
patterns.explanation: と means 'with', and の lets the 'with' phrase describe the thing after it. わかもの との しょうぶ = 'a battle with young people'.
